description: Run one Locus tool by name for a US address or place and get cited public records back: every fact names the agency source and date. Use it for a single question or re-run it for the addresses you follow to see what is newly on file. Free tools answer directly. A place Locus does not cover returns a free diagnostic, never a paid guess. MCP-listed paid tools return an x402 challenge. Obtain user approval for the price, recipient, asset, and chain before retrying identical arguments with _meta["x402/payment"]. REST-only paid tools (including locus-media-locate, locus-media-to-market, paid-only atomics, and promoted dual-rail routes) return tool_requires_rest instead: use the direct POST https://api.locus.report/api/<slug> endpoint and price in the result, or the free MCP counterpart when provided. Install agent skill: npx @velinussage/locus-agent-skill add.
